settings.title: GAME TIME
settings.caption: Sets the maximum time (in minutes) for the round.

settings.title: Assign Teams with Custom Logic
settings.caption: Enable to allow full control of teams assignment during gameplay via custom logic.

settings.title: Bot Count
settings.caption: Sets the maximum number of static AI, this setting is not used for Backfill AI. The site does not publish this one's range, so the panel takes a number until it has read the page.

settings.title: Bot Spawn Type
settings.caption: Controls which type of AI to spawn. Backfill AI will automatically spawn and can be replaced by human players. Static AI is a fixed number that cannot be replaced, for Solo or Co-op experiences.

settings.title: FACTION
settings.caption: Sets the faction for each team.

settings.title: FRIENDLY FIRE
settings.caption: Controls whether damage will be applied to allies.

settings.title: Human Players
settings.caption: Max Player Count Per Team

settings.title: Maximum Game Size
settings.caption: Total number of participants allowed in a game session, including both the maximum number of human players and any static bots.

settings.title: Number of Teams
settings.caption: Sets the numbers of teams that will be in the match.

settings.title: PLAYER DAMAGE MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies damage from all sources. Values less than 1.0 reduce damage from all sources, while values greater than 1.0 increase damage.

settings.title: SQUAD REVIVE
settings.caption: Controls whether soldiers in a squad can revive other players in the squad, regardless of class or gadget.

settings.title: SQUAD SPAWN TYPE
settings.caption: Controls the rules for Squad Spawning, for squad members and squad leaders.

settings.title: Server Team Fill Behavior
settings.caption: Server Team Fill Behavior

settings.title: Squad Size
settings.caption: Sets the maximum number of members per squad.

settings.title: AIM ASSIST
settings.caption: Controls whether Aim Assist is allowed for players using the Aim Assist option. When this is set to OFF, the crosshair will not adjust its speed when tracking over an enemy player.

settings.title: AIM ASSIST ZOOM SNAP
settings.caption: Controls whether Snap-to-target is used for Aim Assisted players. When this is set to OFF, the crosshair will not snap to a nearby target when entering ADS.

settings.title: CLASS LOCK WEAPONS
settings.caption: If enabled, all soldier kits will use their class locked  weapon loadout variants instead of the normal open weapon pool loadouts.

settings.title: DISABLE THIRD PERSON VIEW
settings.caption: Disables the third person view on vehicles.

settings.title: Dark Mode
settings.caption: Enables Dark Mode.

settings.title: Enable Gas Mask - NATO
settings.caption: Enables Gas Mask for NATO Faction.

settings.title: Enable Gas Mask - PAX
settings.caption: Enables Gas Mask for Pax Faction.

settings.title: Freeze Build-Up In Water
settings.caption: Freeze build-up amount while in water.

settings.title: Freeze Build-Up While Moving
settings.caption: Freeze build-up amount while moving.

settings.title: Freeze Build-Up While Sprinting
settings.caption: Freeze build up amount while sprinting.

settings.title: Freeze Build-Up While Stationary
settings.caption: Freeze build-up amount while not moving.

settings.title: Freeze Damage Interval
settings.caption: Freeze damage tick interval.

settings.title: Freeze Max Amount
settings.caption: Sets maximum amount of time required to fully build freeze status.

settings.title: Freeze Spawn Protection Time
settings.caption: Freeze build up immunity window after deploying.

settings.title: GOLMUD TRAIN VARIANT
settings.caption: Sets which train variant will appear in the Railway to Golmud map.

settings.title: Large Heat Source Modifier
settings.caption: Heat build-up for large heat sources (Heat barrel, incendiary grenades, etc).

settings.title: PASSENGER SEATS
settings.caption: Controls whether vehicles take passengers.

settings.title: PROJECTILE SPEED MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies the speed of all projectiles. Values smaller than 100% will slow projectiles, values larger than 100% will increase the speed.

settings.title: REFLECT FRIENDLY FIRE DAMAGE
settings.caption: If the FRIENDLY FIRE modifier is enabled all damage to allies will be reflected back to a player after they kill two allies. Resets after 90 seconds.

settings.title: RELOAD WHOLE MAGAZINES
settings.caption: Controls whether reloading a magazine causes the soldier or vehicle to lose any remaining ammo within the currently loaded magazine.

settings.title: SCOREBOARD TYPE
settings.caption: Controls what type of scoreboard layout to use.

settings.title: SHARED AMMO
settings.caption: Controls whether the soldier uses the default inventory or the Battle Royale inventory.

settings.title: SPOTTING
settings.caption: Controls whether spotting is allowed for players.

settings.title: STATIONARY WEAPON EMPLACEMENTS
settings.caption: Controls whether Stationary Weapon Emplacements should appear in the map (where applicable).

settings.title: SUPPORT AI NAVIGATION
settings.caption: Controls whether AI can navigate the map, turning it off will decrease loading times.

settings.title: Small Heat Source Modifier
settings.caption: Heat build-up amount for small heat source (blow torch).

settings.title: Sprays
settings.caption: Enables or disables the use of sprays.

settings.title: Winter Atmosphere
settings.caption: Enables the screen effect, map visuals and audio for the Empire State map.

settings.title: Winter Mode
settings.caption: Enables Freeze Mechanic.

settings.title: bPortalRestrictedGameFeedback
settings.caption: Controls the degree of feedback given to the player via audio or visual cues.

settings.title: BODY SHOT DAMAGE MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies the damage dealt when successfully landing a body shot. Note that this modifier combines with other damage modifiers.

settings.title: FALL DAMAGE MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies damage taken from falling. Values lower than 100% reduce damage, while values greater than 100% increase damage.

settings.title: HEADSHOT DAMAGE MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies the damage dealt when successfully landing a headshot. Note that this modifier combines with other damage modifiers.

settings.title: INFINITE AMMO
settings.caption: Controls whether soldier weapons have infinite ammo and never need to reload.

settings.title: INFINITE WEAPON MAGAZINES
settings.caption: Control if primary and secondary weapons have infinite magazines.

settings.title: MAN-DOWN TYPE
settings.caption: Determines the Man-Down behavior when a soldier is downed.

settings.title: ON-FOOT DEPLOYMENT
settings.caption: Controls whether players are allowed to deploy on foot as a soldier.

settings.title: PRONE
settings.caption: Controls whether soldiers can go prone.

settings.title: SLIDE
settings.caption: Controls whether soldiers can slide.

settings.title: SOLDIER HEALTH REGENERATION
settings.caption: Controls whether soldiers regenerate health over time after not taking damage.

settings.title: SOLDIER HEALTH REGENERATION RATE
settings.caption: Controls the timing for soldier health regeneration. Values less than 100% slow the time it takes to regenerate to full health, while values greater than 100% regenerate health more quickly.

settings.title: SOLDIER MAXIMUM HEALTH MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies soldier maximum health. Values less than 100% reduce health, while values greater than 100% increase it.

settings.title: SOLDIER MOVE SPEED MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Controls the default speed of Soldier movement, which can then be multiplied by other movement types. Values less than 100% slow down soldier movement, while values greater than 100% increase movement speed.

settings.title: SOLDIER REDEPLOY DELAY MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies the time it takes for soldiers to redeploy. Values less than 100% allow soldiers to redeploy more quickly, while values greater than 100% force soldiers to wait longer before redeploying.

settings.title: SPRINT
settings.caption: Controls whether soldiers are allowed to sprint.

settings.title: STRAFE WHILE SPRINTING
settings.caption: Controls whether soldiers are allowed to strafe laterally while sprinting.

settings.title: EXITING VEHICLES
settings.caption: Controls whether players inside a vehicle can exit the vehicle. When this is set to OFF, players in a vehicle must remain in the vehicle.

settings.title: VEHICLE DAMAGE MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies the damage output of vehicles. Note that this modifier combines with other damage modifiers.

settings.title: VEHICLE HEALTH REGENERATION
settings.caption: Controls whether vehicles regenerate health over time after not taking damage.

settings.title: VEHICLE HEALTH REGENERATION RATE
settings.caption: Controls the timing for vehicle health regeneration. Values less than 100% slow the time it takes to regenerate to full health, while values greater than 100% regenerate health more quickly for all vehicles.

settings.title: VEHICLE MAXIMUM HEALTH MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies the maximum health of all vehicles. Values less than 100% reduces the health of all vehicles, while values greater than 100% increases it.

settings.title: VEHICLE SPAWN DELAY MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies the default timer that spawns or respawns vehicles. Values below 100% make spawns faster, values above 100% delay spawns for longer.

settings.title: ALLY IDENTIFICATION
settings.caption: Controls whether allies are visibly marked as allies when viewed in-game.

settings.title: COMPASS
settings.caption: Controls whether the Compass is displayed in the HUD.

settings.title: CROSSHAIR ALLOWED
settings.caption: Controls whether crosshairs are disabled for players.

settings.title: HUD
settings.caption: Controls whether players have a Heads-Up Display. Does not disable the Full Map.

settings.title: MINIMAP
settings.caption: Controls whether the Minimap is displayed in the HUD.

settings.title: PING BEHAVIOR
settings.caption: Determines the behavior of the Ping command.

settings.title: AI DAMAGE MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies AI damage output from all sources.

settings.title: AI EXITING VEHICLES
settings.caption: Controls whether AI soldiers inside a vehicle can exit the vehicle. When this is set to OFF, AI soldiers in a vehicle must remain in the vehicle.

settings.title: AI HEALTH REGENERATION RATE
settings.caption: Controls the timing for AI soldier health regeneration. Values less than 100% slow the time it takes to regenerate AI soldiers to full health, while values greater than 100% regenerate health more quickly.

settings.title: AI MAN-DOWN TYPE
settings.caption: Determines the Man-Down behavior when an AI soldier is downed.

settings.title: AI ON-FOOT DEPLOYMENT
settings.caption: Controls whether AI are allowed to deploy on foot as soldiers.

settings.title: AI PASSENGER SEATS
settings.caption: Controls whether vehicles take AI passengers.

settings.title: AI PRONE
settings.caption: Controls whether AI soldiers can go prone.

settings.title: AI REDEPLOY DELAY MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies the time it takes for AI soldiers to redeploy. Values less than 100% allow AI soldiers to redeploy more quickly, while values greater than 100% force AI soldiers to wait longer before redeploying.

settings.title: AI SLIDE
settings.caption: Controls whether AI soldiers can slide.

settings.title: AI SOLDIER HEALTH REGENERATION
settings.caption: Controls whether AI soldiers regenerate health over time after not taking damage.

settings.title: AI SOLDIER MAXIMUM HEALTH MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies AI soldier maximum health. Values less than 100% reduce AI health, while values greater than 100% increase it.

settings.title: AI SOLDIER MOVEMENT SPEED
settings.caption: Controls the default speed of AI Soldier movement, which can then be multiplied by other movement types. Values less than 100% slow down AI soldier movement, while values greater than 100% increase movement speed.

settings.title: AI SPRINT
settings.caption: Controls whether AI soldiers are allowed to sprint.

settings.title: AI SQUAD REVIVE
settings.caption: Controls whether AI soldiers in a squad can revive other players in the squad, regardless of class or gadget.

settings.title: AI SQUAD SPAWN
settings.caption: Controls the rules for AI Squad Spawning, for squad members and squad leaders.

settings.title: AI VEHICLE DAMAGE MULTIPLIER
settings.caption: Multiplies AI damage output from vehicles.

fields.title: NAME
fields.caption: The experience name, up to 64 characters. Step one of publish.

fields.title: DESCRIPTION
fields.caption: The experience description, up to 256 characters. Step one of publish.

fields.title: THUMBNAIL
fields.caption: Select an image to represent your experience. The tool's THUMBNAIL panel builds a 352 x 248 JPEG under 78 KB and hands it to the site's own picker.

fields.title: PUBLISH
fields.caption: The site's own publish button. The tool never presses it: publishing is your click.
